The Terms & Conditions: A Karen's Weighty Mistake
A 20-page Weight Gain / Karma comic about an entitled customer who demands unlimited free food, not realizing the "VIP Treatment" comes with a heavy price.

Workflow: Created using a hybrid mix of Virt-A-Mate (VaM) for 3D staging/posing, AI for high-fidelity detailing, and polished with Photoshop/Lightroom. I put a lot of effort into making sure these don't look like standard raw AI generations.
